source_summary: Vertical Chinese landscape with layered blue-green mountains, cliffside pine groves, small pavilion/village clusters, misty water surfaces, garden rocks, willows, bridges, and a large foreground architectural compound. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from motifs.

motifs.name: towering_central_summit
motifs.description: Isolate the tall central upper mountain mass with sheer rounded peak, pale green-blue washes, ocher cliff faces, ink contour lines, fissure strokes, small ledges, and tiny structures or walls perched near the summit and upper clefts. Exclude surrounding inscriptions and seals.
must_preserve: thin ink contour linework along cliff edges
vertical crack and wrinkle strokes
soft green-blue and ocher mineral washes
small summit buildings and wall-like roof/terrace geometry
dark dotted vegetation accents on ledges

motifs.name: misty_left_background_peaks
motifs.description: Isolate the faint left-background mountain silhouettes rising through mist, including the pale washed peak forms and low jagged ridge at the lower left-middle. Avoid nearby calligraphy and red seals.
must_preserve: very soft wash edges fading into mist
muted blue-green silhouettes
minimal ink outlines on nearer low ridge
empty mist space between peak forms

motifs.name: central_cliff_waterfall_pines
motifs.description: Isolate the middle cliff section below the main peak with stacked rocky ledges, a narrow vertical waterfall, and pine clusters standing on terraces. Include the winding ravine linework and rocky slope texture, but avoid the right village cluster.
motifs.role: middle mountain waterfall and pine terrace
must_preserve: narrow pale waterfall strip
angular rock ledges and ink texture strokes
clustered pine trunks and needle masses
green-blue slope washes with ocher rock accents
mist-softened transitions around ravine edges

motifs.name: upper_right_cliff_village
motifs.description: Isolate the small pavilion and house cluster embedded in the upper-right hillside, with surrounding pines, layered roofs, enclosing walls, and rocky terrace ledges. Exclude the nearby red seal.
must_preserve: precise tiled roof geometry
thin architectural wall lines
dark pine needle clusters around buildings
rock ledge outlines beneath the village
subtle tan, green, and gray washes

motifs.name: middle_rocky_cascade_basin
motifs.description: Isolate the rugged mid-lower mountain basin with broken boulders, sloping blue-green ridges, dry stream or cascade channels, and scattered stones leading toward the open water. Keep only the terrain and water-edge rocks, not the foreground buildings.
must_preserve: dense cracked rock texture
stepped boulder outlines
small scattered stones in the water
blue-green ridge washes
pale open water margin and soft shoreline transitions

motifs.name: taihu_rock_willow_pond
motifs.description: Isolate the garden pond scene at left-center: pierced Taihu rock formation, small waterside pavilion, drooping willow clumps, low shrubs, and surrounding pale water. Avoid the large palace complex to the right.
motifs.role: garden rock, pavilion, and willow pond
must_preserve: holes and rounded cavities in the Taihu rock
gray-green wash modeling on the rock
small pavilion roof and rail geometry
long drooping willow leaf strokes
low shrub stippling and pale water gaps

motifs.name: foreground_palace_courtyard
motifs.description: Isolate the main foreground architectural compound with large tiled-roof halls, raised stone terraces, stairways, balustraded bridge and courtyard walls, plus the visible small figures within and in front of the buildings. Exclude unrelated mountain mass where possible.
must_preserve: layered roof ridges and upturned eaves
fine lattice window and wall linework
stone terrace patterning and balustrades
stairs and bridge geometry
small scholar/attendant figures and color accents
warm ocher wall washes and dark roof ink hatching

motifs.name: right_blue_cliff_pine_screen
motifs.description: Isolate the large right-side foreground blue-green cliff and dense pine screen, including the vertical rock face, dark pine canopies, exposed trunks, and foreground shrubs. Keep it separate from the palace roofs behind it.
must_preserve: blue mineral wash on the cliff face
vertical rock contour and wrinkle strokes
dark clustered pine needles
twisting brown-black pine trunks and branches
foreground shrub stippling and layered foliage masses

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
